_description: Synthetic conformance vectors for selective_disclosure issuer-certified interval intersection predicates (#1209). Public statements bind the canonical reduced interval conjunction without revealing certified attribute values or blindings.
privacy_notes: Public statements carry only the 11 wire fields (352 bytes); certified attribute values and blindings never appear in public_statement or encoded_predicate.
predicate_commitment hashes the canonical reduced interval packing L* + U* * 2^64 + canonical_flags * 2^128, making commitments invariant to clause order and hidden attribute values.
All prover_only_synthetic_opening entries use small deterministic test integers and never represent real credentials or media.
